meta_description: Run your own VPN on your own server: what you need, what it costs, and the four steps from an empty VPS to a working access key. Free and open-source.
page_desc: Run the VPN yourself instead of trusting somebody else's. VpnHood! is free and open-source, so the only thing standing between you and your own VPN is a server to put it on.
need_desc: Less than you might think. There is nothing to buy from us.
need_li_server: A server. Any VPS or dedicated machine running Linux or Windows. This is the one thing that costs money, and you pay your cloud provider, not us.
need_li_account: A Google account, if you want the free VpnHood! MANAGER panel to install and run your servers for you.
need_li_skills: No system administration. The install is a single command you paste, or you can hand the panel an SSH login and let it do the work.
need_li_domain: A domain name is optional. Own one and you get a free, automatically renewed TLS certificate; skip it and a self-signed certificate works fine.
steps_title: Four steps to a working VPN
step1: Sign in to VpnHood! MANAGER with your Google account.
step2: Add your server and follow the install steps to put VpnHood! SERVER on it.
step3: Create an access key from the Access Token page.
step4: Share the key. Anyone with VpnHood! CLIENT pastes it in and is connected.
setup_guide: Setup guide: install on Windows, Linux, or Docker
manager_desc: The free panel that installs and runs your servers, so you spend your time on your users instead of on configuration files:
manager_li_deploy: Install a server with one pasted command, or let the panel install it for you over SSH.
manager_li_farm: Spread traffic across several servers at once, weighted by how powerful each one is.
manager_li_monitor: Watch what is happening live: who is connected, how much traffic, which countries.
manager_li_access: Set what each plan allows, then issue access keys against it, with device, traffic, and speed limits.
manager_li_api: Drive all of it from the same REST API the panel itself uses.
client_desc: VpnHood! CLIENT is the app your users install, on Android, Android TV, Windows, and Linux. Key features include:
client_li_fast: Fast and secure VPN connections powered by VpnHood Engine.
client_li_protocol: Steadfast protocol to ensures a smooth, encrypted connection, maintaining a private online presence across various network environments.
client_li_cloak: Cloak Mode for networks that actively probe for VPNs: the connection is deliberately shaped to look like ordinary web traffic, and unauthenticated probes get a plain web-server response instead of anything worth testing.
client_li_proxy: Proxy Mode reaches your server through a SOCKS or HTTP proxy when a direct connection is blocked, which also makes it easy to relay through another network.
client_li_split: Split tunneling for apps, IPs, domains, and country-based filtering.
outro: With VpnHood, users can enjoy a self-hosted VPN solution that is free, customizable, and easy to manage.
